title: Full Practice Tests
description: Put all four sections together under real timing, then read your estimated bands and plan your next steps.

id.title: Simulasi Tes Lengkap
id.description: Gabungkan keempat bagian dengan waktu sesungguhnya, lalu baca perkiraan band-mu dan rencanakan langkah berikutnya.

nodes.title: Timed Section Practice
nodes.summary: Complete each section on its own under real time limits on screen.

objectives.text: Finish a full Listening (40 questions) and Reading (40 questions) section within the time limits
Write Task 1 and Task 2 within 60 minutes and meet both word counts
Complete all three Speaking parts in 11–14 minutes

id.title: Latihan Bagian Berwaktu
id.summary: Mengerjakan setiap bagian secara terpisah dengan batas waktu sesungguhnya di layar.

objectives.timed-listening-reading: Menyelesaikan satu bagian Listening (40 soal) dan Reading (40 soal) penuh dalam batas waktu
objectives.timed-writing: Menulis Task 1 dan Task 2 dalam 60 menit dan memenuhi kedua batas minimal kata
objectives.timed-speaking: Menyelesaikan ketiga bagian Speaking dalam 11–14 menit

nodes.title: Full Mock Test
nodes.summary: Take a complete Listening, Reading and Writing test in one sitting, plus a Speaking interview.

objectives.text: Complete Listening, Reading and Writing back to back in about two and a half hours without breaks
Apply the strategy for each question type under full-test pressure

id.title: Simulasi Tes Lengkap
id.summary: Mengerjakan Listening, Reading dan Writing lengkap dalam satu sesi, ditambah wawancara Speaking.

objectives.one-sitting: Menyelesaikan Listening, Reading dan Writing berturut-turut dalam sekitar dua setengah jam tanpa jeda
objectives.keep-strategy: Menerapkan strategi setiap tipe soal di bawah tekanan tes lengkap

nodes.title: Score Review & Test-day Plan
nodes.summary: Turn mock results into estimated bands, find your weakest areas and plan for test day.

objectives.text: Convert raw Listening and Reading scores to approximate bands and calculate an estimated overall band
Compare estimated bands with the target score required by a university or scholarship and pick the weakest section to improve
Plan test-day logistics, including ID, the separate Speaking time and the option of One Skill Retake

id.title: Evaluasi Skor & Rencana Hari Tes
id.summary: Mengubah hasil simulasi menjadi perkiraan band, menemukan kelemahan dan merencanakan hari tes.

objectives.estimate-bands: Mengonversi skor mentah Listening dan Reading ke perkiraan band dan menghitung perkiraan overall band
objectives.target-gaps: Membandingkan perkiraan band dengan skor target universitas atau beasiswa dan memilih bagian terlemah untuk ditingkatkan
objectives.test-day: Merencanakan persiapan hari tes, termasuk kartu identitas, jadwal Speaking yang terpisah dan opsi One Skill Retake
